package position

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

// ListPositions lists positions with resolved relations.
type ListPositions struct {
	Positions       repository.PositionRepository
	PositionTechs   repository.PositionTechRepository
	PositionCourses repository.PositionCourseRepository
}

// Handle returns positions with technologies and courses.
func (uc ListPositions) Handle(ctx context.Context, lang string, filter filters.PositionFilters, onlyActiveCourses bool) ([]domain.Position, int, error) {
	positions, total, err := uc.Positions.List(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	for idx := range positions {
		techs, err := uc.PositionTechs.ListTechs(ctx, positions[idx].ID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		courses, err := uc.PositionCourses.ListCourses(ctx, positions[idx].ID, lang, onlyActiveCourses)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		attachRelations(&positions[idx], techs, courses)
	}

	return positions, total, nil
}
